vision.title: Augmented Consciousness
vision.desc1: Moving beyond simple consumption to proactive understanding.
vision.desc2: In a world drowning in information, Povzetkar is the answer to the starvation for wisdom. Not just another summary app, but a personal AI analyst designed to serve as an extension of your own consciousness.
vision.pillar2_desc: Connecting data to identify trends and timelines, revealing the 'how' and 'why'.
vision.pillar3_desc: Retrospectively analyzing past predictions to foster critical thinking and source reliability.
vision.pillar4_desc: Automated verification of system insights against real-world outcomes.

footer.mission: Building the personal operating system for universal understanding.

system.focus_text: Currently bridging the gap between automated Knowledge and human-centered Wisdom.

changelog.title: Strategic Updates
changelog.entry1_desc: Integrated a real-time system discovery layer for release lineage and strategic trajectory.
changelog.entry2_desc: Migrated to Distroless Java 25, eliminating 100% of OS-level attack surfaces.
changelog.entry3_desc: Launched custom prompt templates, allowing for specialized topic-level summarization logic.
changelog.entry4_desc: Implemented global error boundaries and automated retry mechanisms for absolute stability.

roadmap.title: Vision Path
roadmap.q1_desc_full: Deepening source contextualization. Establishing chronological awareness and cross-domain pattern recognition.
roadmap.q2_desc_full: Launching the Reality Check System. Automated verification of past predictions and source reliability scoring.
roadmap.q3_desc: Comprehensive searchable archive with advanced filtering and multi-user administration.
roadmap.q4_desc: RAG pipeline integration for interactive, context-aware conversations with your data.
roadmap.q5_desc: Trend detection and author bias assessment for high-level strategic oversight.
